notices.title: Economics v2 — soft announce (not activated)
notices.body: Public RFC locks Economics v2 design: target 0.1 HMC/block, ~4y halvings, 0.002 tail, pool from emission, no airdrops. Not live yet — activation only after soak + ≥14 days notice. Live payouts remain current rc18 rules.

notices.title: 0.1.0-rc18 — Blake3 share-PPS · CUDA/OpenCL
notices.body: Channel 0.1.0-rc18: Blake3 PoH LIVE (tip ≥ #485000). Pool pays verified shares (SHARE_STRICT PPS at M/1024). Pool GH/s is blake3_pow_ghs (shares/wall). NVIDIA: CUDA worker (RTX 50 needs CUDA ≥12.8). AMD: OpenCL device Blake3 (RX 580 2048SP in-matrix). Hunt = Linux + bubblewrap (not Windows).

notices.title: Share-PPS (verified shares)
notices.body: Each share_nonce is a PoH hit with work % (M/1024) == 0, verified by the coordinator. SHARE_STRICT pays those shares; client hashrate_gh_s is not the paycheck. Dig/Hunt remain the useful-work / bounty lanes.

notices.title: Found-hit recheck
notices.body: Coordinator samples found=false submits and rejects missed_found_unreported if the lease prefix contains a valid PoH hit you did not report.
